acquisitionGuide.summary: Convert an owned Itali GTB at Benny’s Original Motor Works.
requirements: Compatible donor: Itali GTB.
A free personal-vehicle storage space and funds for the conversion.
steps: Obtain a legitimate personal Itali GTB. The Benny’s website lists compatible donor models; eligible stolen low-value donors must first be claimed as personal vehicles.
Drive the donor into Benny’s Original Motor Works in Strawberry. Select the upgrade to Itali GTB Custom.
Pay the conversion fee. The donor becomes this converted model and can be kept in a personal garage.
caveats: The listed conversion fee is separate from the donor vehicle and optional modifications.
A Benny’s conversion is different from an HSW conversion.
